summary: Fresh end-to-end test of ZipForge (Expo/RN + FastAPI + Mongo). Backend: 12/15 pytest tests pass. Health, snippets (8), AI chat simple (with & without code context), session history, session list & delete, projects CRUD, Termux export ALL work correctly. CRITICAL: /api/forge/pipeline returns 502 Bad Gateway via public ingress because 3 sequential Claude Sonnet 4.5 calls take ~95s (verified 95.16s locally on backend) and Cloudflare ingress cuts off around ~100s (even LiteLLM auto-retries can push it further). Frontend loads cleanly on mobile viewport — 'ZipForge' + 'Import ZIP' + 'New blank project' + 'No projects yet' empty state all render; all 6 tabs visible (FORGE/EDITOR/PREVIEW/AI LAB/LIBRARY/PIPELINE); 'New blank project' creates project & routes to editor with index.html + PREVIEW/ASK AI/TERMUX action pills; Library loads 8 snippets from backend and PY filter correctly narrows to FastAPI-only; Pipeline shows all 6 target chips + run-pipeline-btn; AI Lab shows welcome screen with 5 quick-prompt chips + chat-input + send-chat-btn. Minor RN warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

critical.issue: Public URL returns 502 Bad Gateway (Cloudflare). Direct localhost:8001 works and completes in ~95s. 3 sequential LLM calls + LiteLLM retries exceed ingress timeout (~100s). Pipeline UI will always fail for real users. Fix: convert endpoint to async job pattern — POST returns {job_id} immediately, worker runs pipeline in background, GET /api/forge/runs/{job_id} returns status/files. Alternatively stream progress via SSE. This is the same 3-LLM chain E1 built, so the payload cannot simply be sped up.

integration_issues.issue: Will always fail with 502 in production due to ingress timeout on the backend endpoint. UI has no timeout guard beyond default fetch, so user will see the generic 'Pipeline failed' error after ~100s. Depends on the backend fix above.

react_native_issues.component: React Native Web (some component using props.pointerEvents)
react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning at runtime: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Not blocking, but should be migrated. Reference: appears at app boot in Expo web preview console.

action_items: CRITICAL: refactor /api/forge/pipeline to async job pattern. Return 202 with {job_id} immediately, run the 3-stage chain in a background task (asyncio.create_task or arq/APScheduler), and expose GET /api/forge/runs/{job_id} for status polling. Update the Pipeline UI (forge.tsx) to poll every 2-3s and stream file cards as each stage completes.

OPTIONAL alternative: stream Server-Sent Events from /api/forge/pipeline with intermediate events per stage so the Cloudflare connection stays warm (SSE keepalive) instead of hanging on a single response.
Migrate props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents wherever it is used (grep the repo for pointerEvents=).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forge_pipeline runs 3 sequential LlmChat.send_message calls with no timeout guard and no way to report progress — architecturally guaranteed to hit ingress timeout in production.
server.py uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI 0.100+; recommend the lifespan context manager.

logger is defined AFTER it is used inside ai_chat/ai_chat_simple/forge_pipeline exception handlers (logger.exception). Because logging.basicConfig + logger= are at the bottom of the file, the first exception before module fully loaded would NameError. In practice module import completes before requests hit so it works, but move logger setup to the top of the file.
No pagination on /api/projects, /api/forge/runs, /api/ai/sessions/{id}/messages — hard-coded to_list(200/50/500). Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.

success_rate.backend: 80% (12/15 pytest — the 3 failures are all caused by the single ingress-timeout root cause on /api/forge/pipeline)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for tested surface (home, tabs, new blank project, editor pills, library snippets+filter, pipeline UI shell, AI lab shell) — Pipeline RUN not executed via UI because it depends on the failing backend endpoint

seed_data_creation: None. Tests use TEST_ prefixed data and clean up after themselves.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent implements async job pattern for /api/forge/pipeline: (1) POST should return 202 + {job_id} in <2s, (2) GET /api/forge/runs/{job_id} should return {status, files} where status transitions pending->running->completed, (3) UI Pipeline tab should poll and render files as they arrive. Backend tests: reuse /app/backend/tests/test_zipforge.py — update TestForgePipeline to poll instead of expecting synchronous 200. Frontend: verify 'INIT SYNTHESE' button eventually shows 3 file cards without a 502 error in the console.
rca_of_issue: Root cause: /api/forge/pipeline does 3 synchronous await chat.send_message() calls to Claude Sonnet 4.5 via LiteLLM. Each call takes 20-40s + LiteLLM auto-retries transient errors, so total wall time is 60-120s. Kubernetes/Cloudflare ingress has ~100s idle-response timeout, so the client (and pytest) receives a Cloudflare 502 HTML page while the backend process is still running (logs confirm LiteLLM keeps issuing completions after the client already got 502). Reproduction: curl -X POST https://app-innovation-hub-5.preview.emergentagent.com/api/forge/pipeline -d '{"prompt":"x","target_env":"python"}' -> 502 HTML. Same request against http://localhost:8001 succeeds in ~95s. Mitigation: convert to background job + polling (documented in action_items).
